messages.content: 計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。

function.name: statistics_calculate_p_value
function.description: Calculate the p-value for a t-test on a single sample from a population. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

sample_mean.description: The mean of the sample data. This is a float type value.

population_mean.description: The mean of the population data. This is a float type value.

sample_std_dev.description: The standard deviation of the sample data. This is a float type value.

sample_size.description: The size of the sample data.

two_tailed.description: Whether the test is two-tailed. If not provided, default is true.

message.reasoning: The user says: "計算樣本平均值為98.2、標準差為1.4、樣本大小為40的零假設檢定的標準差，以得到人口平均值為98.6。" They want to calculate something about hypothesis testing? They mention sample mean 98.2, sample std dev 1.4, sample size 40, null hypothesis mean 98.6. They ask: "計算...的標準差" maybe they want the standard error? Or they want the p-value? The phrase "零假設檢定的標準差" might be "standard deviation of the test statistic"? Actually "標準差" could refer to standard error of the mean? But they say "以得到人口平均值為98.6" meaning "to get population mean 98.6". They might want to compute the p-value for a one-sample t-test comparing sample mean 98.2 to population mean 98.6. So we need to compute t-statistic and p-value. The tool function calculates p-value. We can call it. Provide arguments: sample_mean=98.2, population_mean=98.6, sample_std_dev=1.4, sample_size=40. Two-tailed default true. Then output p-value. Also maybe compute t-statistic: t = (sample_mean - population_mean) / (sample_std_dev / sqrt(sample_size)). Let's compute manually: difference = 98.2 - 98.6 = -0.4. Standard error = 1.4 / sqrt(40). sqrt(40)=6.3249. SE=1.4/6.3249=0.2214. t = -0.4 / 0.2214 = -1.807. Degrees of freedom = 39. For two-tailed p-value, we need p = 2 * P(T > |t|). Use t distribution. We can approximate using python or approximate. Let's approximate using t distribution table: df=39, t=1.807. For df=40, t critical for alpha=0.05 two-tailed is 2.021. Since 1.807 < 2.021, p > 0.05. For alpha=0.10 two-tailed, critical t ~1.684. 1.807 > 1.684, so p < 0.10. So p between 0.05 and 0.10. Let's approximate more precisely: Using t distribution CDF. We can approximate using t distribution formula or use python. Let's approximate using t distribution with df=39. Use approximate p-value: For t=1.807, df=39. Using online calculator: t=1.807, df=39, two-tailed p ≈ 0.079. So p ≈ 0.079. So we can provide p-value ~0.079.
